summary: account page + nav-bar read tier from Clerk metadata; never updated by Stripe webhook → Pro users see 'Free'
description:
Live: user upgraded via Stripe (webhook delivered, Postgres users.tier='pro', /api/quota returns limit=500), but the account page still shows 'Current Free' and the nav-bar still treats them as free.

Two sources of truth, not synced:
  - Postgres users.tier  ← Stripe webhook (handleCheckoutCompleted) writes here.
                          requireUser() / /api/quota / /api/query all read from here.
  - Clerk user.publicMetadata.tier  ← never written by anything in the codebase.
                          src/app/(app)/account/page.tsx:20 and src/components/nav-bar.tsx:23 read from here.

Server-side gating (quota limit, model selection) works correctly. UI display is wrong.

Fix: collapse to one source of truth — Postgres, via /api/quota which already returns { used, limit, tier }. The account page already fetches /api/quota; just use the tier field. nav-bar needs the same fetch.

Done when:
- account/page.tsx reads tier from /api/quota response, not user.publicMetadata
- nav-bar.tsx does the same
- both treat 'pro' as the upgraded state
- regression test asserts the file does not read user.publicMetadata.tier
